mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, points, create_time AS createTime FROM user_points_ledger WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_points_ledger (order_id, user_id, points) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{points})
INSERT INTO user_points_account (user_id, points) VALUES (#{userId}, #{points}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE points = points + VALUES(points), update_time = NOW()
